result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue: white text on the promotional banner has severely insufficient contrast against its light pastel green background.

issues.description: The heading ('3 free deliveries for you') and promo code details ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') inside the promotional banner use white text on a very light mint green background, resulting in extremely poor color contrast and making the offer details nearly illegible.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text color to a dark shade (such as dark green or near-black) or use a much darker green background so the text meets WCAG contrast requirements.
